title: Pipeline Failure Runbook
description: Investigation and remediation steps for training pipeline failures.
steps: 1. Retrieve recent pipeline run logs and identify the failed stage.
2. Classify error: data_error | resource_error | code_error | transient_error.
3. If transient (network, timeout): retry pipeline once.
4. If data_error: run data validation and fix before retry.
5. If code_error: inspect recent git commits for regressions.
6. If resource_error: check system health (CPU, memory, disk).
7. Submit RETRY_PIPELINE through policy engine if retry count < 3.
8. If retry fails: escalate for human review.
